errors.text_span: in the IE-Indic family, mBERT-R₂ (light green) shows the highest effect
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies mBERT-R₂ (light green) as having the highest effect in the IE-Indic family. Visually, the mBERT-B₂ bar (light red/pink) is the tallest in that group, with a value of approximately 25, whereas the mBERT-R₂ bar is only around 21.
The x-axis label is 'IE-Slavic', and the axis itself is titled 'family'. Combining them into 'IE-Slavic family' is redundant.
